name: workbench
description: Full-stack starter: TanStack Start frontend + Convex backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
